connector.name: MCP Server by SavantoAI
connector.registryDescription: Manage your Savanto store from your AI: catalog, content, prompts, and analytics, by chat.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.savanto.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the savantoai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: SAVANTO_API_KEY
env.description: A Savanto secret API key (if_sk_…) from your dashboard. Local/stdio use only; the hosted remote uses one-click OAuth instead.
